conclusion: The count guard changes source-observable behavior and cannot be justified as unreachable or a mechanical wire/native conversion. Real caller kinds can reach count. Loaded file rows do not determine the compared tail bytes.

original_instructions.fact: Count is shifted left three and passed as a zero-extended 16-bit size to f_171C_13CA.
The second read receives precisely that count*8 size, then the NDX handle closes.
After lower-bound search, cursor*8 is added to the retained index pointer, global candidate is written, and id at candidate+4 is read without a cursor<count branch.
Only after id equality, kind at candidate+6 is read and compared. Successful equality returns the candidate pointer.
Payload paragraph request is ((unsigned16 size+15)>>4), plus two header paragraphs.
Master pointer receives header segment+2: payload begins at header+32.
Split path copies the current 32-byte header to header+requested_paras*16 and changes next block type/paras; it never clears payload/slack.
If free_block.paras-2<=requested_paras, the allocator consumes the whole free block and retains its larger physical paragraph size.

source_anchors.source: long size;                  /* +02 requested size in bytes */
unsigned paras;             /* +06 size in paragraphs incl. header */

ownership.tail: At least eight bytes of the index block's paragraph padding.
ownership.fields_read: id and kind reside entirely in that padding.
ownership.initialization: Neither original Ralloc nor OpenIndex writes these bytes. Source initialization does not establish them as zero or a sentinel. Free-list reuse can retain previous payload contents.

ownership.fields_read: candidate.id overlays the high 16 bits of next.size (+4); candidate.kind overlays the low byte of next.paras (+6).
ownership.initialization: Next header contents depend on original free/allocated block history. There is no table-owned sentinel.

ownership.tail: Additional retained slack may precede the next header.
ownership.fields_read: One-past bytes can remain stale payload instead of next header.
ownership.initialization: Occurs when original free_block.paras differs from request by at most two. No zeroing occurs.

caller_reachability.music_witness: Under enabled music, EndGameDialog selects song10010 (0x271a); myBeginSong -> f_284A_0013 -> f_0000_0193 -> f_1A53_00BA -> db_LoadObject -> DBRecall -> FindIndex.
caller_reachability.normal_vga_database_prefix: Without optional language.dat, IBMInitStuff opens SHARED, then graphics selection opens HCEGANT; main later opens SOUND. db_LoadObject tries that source handle order on a cache miss.
caller_reachability.search_ranks: For song10010/kind18: SHARED449 returns interior rank308 miss; HCEGANT271 reaches one-past rank271; SOUND120 has the actual hit at rank64. Thus the one-past read is not excluded by successful final resource lookup.
caller_reachability.pattern_witness: LoadMonoPats requests kind22 ids10000 and10010. Each provided asset has max kind<22, so every such individual lookup reaches count. This is a source query witness; these three VGA asset files do not themselves prove a successful monochrome run.
caller_reachability.boundaries: Cache hits can avoid the DB search. Optional language/other graphics resources alter the searched prefix. These facts do not prove which bytes a complete DOS game run finds at the HCEGANT tail.

minimal_experiment.observation: Six OpenIndex/FindIndex pairs execute original allocation helpers with initialized valid free heaps. Two nonzero fills remain unchanged in HCEGANT/SHARED padding. SOUND split allocation exposes a next free header. Original FindIndex reads the one-past id word; source read extent is exactly20+count*8.
minimal_experiment.limitation: This probes raw ownership with modeled external file/format services; it is not a natural shipped-game false-hit witness or a new semantic acceptance. There is no native candidate comparison.

native_resolution.reason: Current native handle data uses malloc(requested_bytes); charged paragraph size only accounts capacity. Rounding native allocation could make odd tail storage addressable but cannot recover source tail contents. It also cannot account for even-count header reads or absorbed-block slack.
rejected_shortcuts: Use successful existing-record recalls as a general miss proof
native_resolution.honest_state: Keep the guard explicitly SEMANTIC/PORT-BLOCKING and the general native equivalence gate closed. No production edit is recommended from this investigation.
native_resolution.possible_future_work: A source-driven DOS heap representation preserving original block headers, padding, addressable arena, and actual allocation/reuse state could retain the predicate as a platform memory boundary; allocator algorithms must remain canonical. Initial/reused tail contents and real false-hit reachability still require evidence. A partial synthetic adjacency view is insufficient.

composition_limit: Caller reachability above is a fully static source/asset argument, separately corroborated by standalone original OpenIndex/FindIndex pairs. A composed original db_LoadObject experiment was attempted but failed at unmodeled continuation execution and is excluded from positive evidence; no full-game changed-return witness is established.
